programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés, Concha Buika, Rodney Barreto & Dreiser Durruthy Bombale
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music. Together with vocalists Concha Buika and Dreiser Durruthy Bombale, Rodney Barreto on drums, Gaston Joya on double bass, Yaroldy Abreu Robles on congas, and Reinaldo Melian Alvarez on trumpet, the legendary pianist brings the streets of Havana to the festival's stage.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.title: Simone Lamsma, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek. The composer initially intended to dedicate the piece to the young Kotek, but eventually dedicated it to another violinist, Leopold Auer, as he was afraid of the gossip the dedication would cause. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on April 10, 2022.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.desc: When the banks committed the greatest fraud in US history, four outsiders risked it all to take them down. Based on the unbelievable true story and best-selling book from the author of The Blind Side and Moneyball, critics are calling The Big Short “brilliant and explosive”...

programme.title: Gotti
programme.desc: GOTTI follows infamous crime boss John Gotti's rise to become the “Teflon Don” of the Gambino Crime Family in New York City. Spanning three decades and recounted by his son John Jr., GOTTI examines Gotti's tumultuous life as her and his wife attempt to hold the family together...

programme.title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
programme.desc: After being caught with another girl in the back seat of a car on prom night, Cameron is shipped off to a conversion therapy centre that treats teens "struggling with same-sex attraction".

programme.title: Love Sarah
programme.desc: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page Conners are a mother-and-daughter con team. Their cunning plan? Max singles out a wealthy man and convinces him to marry her. Once married, Page seduces the unsuspecting groom whilst ensuring Max catches them in the an uncompromising position. Cue divorce proceedings and a large settlement. What could possibly go wrong, except maybe falling in love? Contains strong language and sexual content.

programme.title: Say your Prayers
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers who have become radical Christian hitmen head to the countryside in Ilkley, directed by Father Enoch. Their task? To take out Professor John Huxley, a well-known atheist author.

programme.title: RoboCop Prime Directives 1
programme.desc: Robocop accidentally finds out about a bad bunch of government officials up to no good, and they need to be stopped.

programme.title: #No Joke
programme.desc: A musician's journey to create a song with some of the biggest stars in the industry. Along the way, he faces up to his painful past, while giving viewers a deep personal insight into the issue of bullying.

programme.title: The Ninth Gate
programme.desc: A rare book dealer, while seeking out the last two copies of a demon text, gets drawn into a conspiracy with supernatural overtones. Starring: Johnny Depp, Frank Langella, Lena Olin

programme.title: State Of Grace
programme.desc: In this neo-noir crime film, an undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in New York City's Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia, which is now led by two of his childhood friends (Gary Oldman and Ed Harris).

programme.title: Throw Momma From The Train
programme.desc: In this black-Comedy spin-off of Alfred Hitchcock's STRANGERS ON A TRAIN, a writing student tries to persuade his instructor to trade murders.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: During an annual month-long polar night, a small Alaskan town is attacked by a bloodthirsty gang of vampires.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
programme.desc: Clary Fray's search for her missing mother leads her to a dangerous alternate New York called the Shadow World

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: A reporter wakes up in a morgue as a member of the undead, vowing revenge against the sect which put her there

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: During an annual month-long polar night, a small Alaskan town is attacked by a bloodthirsty gang of vampires.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend (James Ransone) hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra (Mya Taylor), embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumour. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: Rare Exports: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: Do you believe in Santa Claus? On the eve of Christmas a young boy sets out to discover the truth behind several strange goings on in his small isolated village. Why have all the reindeer been slaughtered? Who took all the hairdryers and radiators? And where have all the children gone? Seal the chimney. Lock the doors. Hide your children. This year the real Santa Claus is coming to town.

programme.title: The Three Dogateers Save Christmas
programme.desc: When a couple of burglars make off with their family's presents and decorations, the Three Dogateers set off on a journey to sniff out the bad guys and save Christmas!

programme.title: First Kill
programme.desc: No time off when it comes to crime! Starring Bruce Willis (Looper) and Gethin Anthony (Game of Thrones) this nail-biting, explosive thriller sees a holiday gone horribly wrong! In an attempt to reconnect with his son, Will (Haydn Christensen Jumper) takes his family to the cabin where he grew up. However, their trip takes a deadly turn when they witness the murder of a crooked police officer.

programme.title: When the Screaming Starts
programme.desc: Aidan has a dream that dream is bathed in blood and glory as he documents his attempt to become one of the UKs most infamous serial killers. With a documentary film crew on hand, Aidans dream is set to become a reality. Recruiting a gang of damaged souls with the same urge to kill, he soon realises that some of his blood-soaked cult members may be a little more into the murder than he is.

programme.title: Infernal
programme.desc: In the vein of The Omen and Insidious, this dark horror is set to petrify! Newlyweds Nathan and Sophia are looking ahead to their bright future, but are unaware of the darkness that is about to entail. When their first child Imogene begins exhibiting strange and demonic behaviour, their future is left uncertain as they desperately search for answers to free their daughter. Deeply disturbing!

programme.title: Hostile
programme.desc: A worldwide epidemic has killed most of the planets population. The few survivors struggle to find food and shelter. But they are not alone On her way back to base camp from a scavenging mission, Juliette (Brittany Ashworth) has a terrible accident. Stuck in her car, with a broken leg, in the middle of an unforgiving desert, she must survive the perils of the post-apocalypse, while a strange creature prowls around. . .

programme.title: Candy Corn
programme.desc: A traveling carnival is in town for the weekend and local outcast, Jacob Atkins, has been hired as one of the freaks in the events main attraction. Meanwhile, a group of local bullies are planning their annual public hazing of Jacob, but this year things go too far

programme.title: Mississippi Grind
programme.desc: Gerry (Ben Mendelsohn) is a talented but struggling poker player, about to be swallowed up by his unshakable gambling habit, when his luck begins to change after he meets the young, charismatic Curtis (Ryan Reynolds).

programme.title: Middle of Nowhere
programme.desc: With her husband in prison, life seems bleak for Ruby, but a chance encounter puts her back on a journey towards a future she thought was lost.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby

programme.title: Annie Claus Is Coming To Town
programme.desc: Santa's daughter takes her first trip away from the North Pole during the Christmas season.

programme.title: Christmas In My Heart

programme.desc: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

programme.title: Bliss
programme.desc: In this quirky love story, a divorced man meets a woman who is living on the streets and is convinced that the world around them is just a simulation.

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs
programme.desc: A womanizing Viagra salesman with no sense of direction or responsibility falls in love with a free-spirited woman.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: Unjustly fired by a spoilt and selfish yacht owner, Kate gets payback when he falls overboard and wakes up with amnesia...

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: Sound Of Christmas
programme.desc: Whilst trying to reignite his daughter's passion for Christmas, Brad, falls in love with piano teacher, Lizzie. However, their romance is threatened by Brad's business interests.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown and the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, he forms a close friendship with Pamela and her son Westin. But there's one problem, he's already engaged!

programme.desc: Photographer Holly returns to Gulfport, Mississippi for Christmas. Their traditional holiday light show has been revived again since a hurricane struck five years earlier. She is shocked to learn the festival is run by her high school sweetheart, Mike.

programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: Love's Sweet Recipe
programme.desc: Courtney is a chef who runs her family's restaurant. Armed with a family heirloom her father left behind called the "Rule Book of Love" to guide the way. Handsome Jake is there to help, and she finds love in a place she least expected.

programme.title: From The Heart
programme.desc: Kathy Yoder has left her Amish ways and is a successful travel guide writer. When Kathy goes home to settle her dad's affairs, she's reminded of her life before she left the Amish community, including her old love, Isaac. Will Kathy decide to stay or return to her traveling lifestyle?

programme.title: Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Crooks and cops chase siblings with fake cash in Canada. Stars Matthew Knight.

programme.title: A Christmas in Tennessee
programme.desc: Allison, her daughter, and her mother, run a bakery in a small mountain town.

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Holly Logan returns to Gulfport for a Christmas light show.

programme.title: The Christmas Snowman.
programme.desc: Woman's wished-for perfect man comes to life as a snowman.

programme.desc: A TV host must choose between chasing ratings or following her heart when she falls for a handsome guest.

programme.title: Calling for Love
programme.desc: A podcast host who is cynical about love meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller.

programme.desc: Vicki goes undercover in a fertility clinic whose unusual success rate is due to the actions of a Swartalfen.

programme.title: That's My Boy (2012)
programme.desc: A father moves in on the eve of his son's wedding and promptly begins feuding with the bride-to-be.

There the man falls for a princess, is hailed as "the chosen" by the oppressed people and ultimately leads a revolt that topples the government and frees the slaves. He heads off with the princess to visit Egypt....

programme.title: Daddy Day Camp
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE pals Charlie and Phil are back in this hilarious, all-new adventure: DADDY DAY CAMP! When the dads expand their childcare magic to Camp Driftwood - serving up sports, crafts and teaching the kids a thing or two about nature, they discover the camp has everything it needs except a plan to put the bullies of rival Camp Canola to shame. With some quick thinking, teamwork, a secret weapon and some off-the-wall crazy antics, the dads and kids unite to make sure DADDY DAY CAMP secures its rightful place in kid camp history!

programme.title: King of California
programme.desc: An unstable dad who after getting out of a mental institution tries to convince his daughter that there's Spanish gold buried somewhere under suburbia.

programme.title: Happily
programme.desc: Tom and Janet have been happily married for years. But a visit from a mysterious stranger leads to a dead body, a lot of questions, and a tense couples' trip with friends who may not actually be friends at all.

programme.title: I've Never Wanted Anyone More

In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

When a deadly plague strikes the prison, he faces the ultimate test of character, transforming his dire circumstances into a chance for renewal.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés, Concha Buika, Rodney Barreto & Dreiser Durruthy Bombale
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music. Together with vocalists Concha Buika and Dreiser Durruthy Bombale, Rodney Barreto on drums, Gaston Joya on double bass, Yaroldy Abreu Robles on congas, and Reinaldo Melian Alvarez on trumpet, the legendary pianist brings the streets of Havana to the festival's stage.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic & David Cohen
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections') is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.title: Elton John
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Elton John featuring unforgettable version of his hits: "Tiny Dancer", "Rocket Man", "Your Song" and many more…

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Un joven desesperado por conectarse con las personas cercanas a él recurre a medidas extremas para lograrlo.

programme.title: Text To Kill
programme.desc: Teens band together to investigate the source of anonymous messages that threaten to expose their secrets.

programme.title: Paris, Wine and Romance
programme.desc: Isabella, la propietaria de la bodega familiar de Oregon, da un gran salto y participa en una prestigiosa competencia de vinos en París. Allí conoce a su mayor competidor, Jacques, de una de las familias vitivinícolas más importantes del mundo.

programme.title: Disparando a perros
programme.desc: Un párroco católico y un joven idealista se ven envueltos en el genocidio de Ruanda de 1994. Ante la dramática situación deben decidir si permanecen con los miles de Tutsis a punto de ser masacrados o huir hacia la libertad. Los cascos azules de la ONU, impotentes por el mandato de no intervención, solo pudieron disparar a los perros que devoraban los cadáveres de las víctimas.

programme.title: Él
programme.desc: Francisco Galván de Montemayor, un hombre adinerado de apariencia tranquila, asiste como cada Jueves Santo a la iglesia. Al ver los sensuales pies de una joven sentada en primera fila se queda prendado de su serena belleza. Tras cortejarla, conquista a Gloria y se casa con ella. A partir de la misma noche de bodas, los celos lo transforman en un ser obsesivo y paranoico, que solo ve el asesinato y la mutilación como una solución a su locura.

programme.title: Cal
programme.desc: Cal es un chico católico de 19 años que vive con su padre en un barrio protestante de Irlanda del Norte. Cuando un día, tras diversas amenazas, les incendian la casa, Cal decide ingresar en el IRA. Su único consuelo será el amor que siente por Marcella, una viuda cuyo marido fue asesinado por la banda terrorista.

programme.title: Absolución
programme.desc: En un colegio público católico, el padre Goddard se enfrenta a un terrible dilema: mantener el secreto de confesión o acudir a la policía para relatar el asesinato cometido por uno de sus alumnos. Benjamin Stanfield, en confesión, le dice al padre Goddard que asesinó a su amigo Blakey y lo enterró en el bosque. Pronto, el compañero de Benjamin, Arthur Dyson, desaparece misteriosamente.

programme.title: En Compañía de Lobos
programme.desc: Lobos y criaturas fantásticas acechan los sueños de la joven Rosaleen, quien sueña que debe atravesar el bosque oscuro para llegar a casa de su abuela.

programme.title: El Lute II: Mañana seré libre
programme.desc: El Lute escapa de la prisión de El Puerto de Santa María. Lo primero que hace tras su huida es acudir a sus hermanos para pedirles ayuda.

programme.title: El Lute: Camina o Revienta
programme.desc: En 1960, una familia de quinquis recorre Extremadura. La vida tan dura que llevan causa la muerte de la madre. El hijo, Eleuterio Sánchez, roba unas gallinas y es condenado a seis meses de cárcel...

programme.title: 97 Minutos
programme.desc: Un agente infiltrado es la única esperanza de un avión secuestrado a punto de estrellarse.

programme.title: Sweet Home
programme.desc: Alicia sorprende a su novio Simón con una cena romántica para dos en un edificio casi abandonado.

programme.title: Magnicidios II
programme.desc: Los asesinatos de Carranza, Villa y Obregón en los últimos años de la Revolución Mexicana.

programme.title: Agatha y la verdad del crimen
programme.desc: Agatha Christie investiga un asesinato real.

programme.title: Vigilante Diaries
programme.desc: Un equipo de agentes de operaciones secretas convertido en justicieros es liderado por 'El Vigilante'.

programme.title: Warrior (2011)
programme.desc: Warrior cuenta la inspiradora historia de una familia separada que encuentra redención en el sitio menos esperado... un ring de artes marciales mixtas.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de un despiadado jefe mafioso, un conductor que se da a la fuga después de un violento atraco deberá entregar a un joven miembro de la banda en una emboscada para ejecutarlo.

programme.title: Furia
programme.desc: Lee Gunner, un veterano de guerra se ve obligado a regresar a un mundo de violencia y desesperación cuando sus hijos son secuestrados por una peligrosa banda de narcotraficantes.

programme.title: Infiel
programme.desc: El matrimonio de Edward y Connie Sumner parece ir bien. Pero un día, en Manhattan, Connie conoce a Paul, un atractivo coleccionista de libros de origen francés. Ambos comienzan una relación adúltera de insospechadas consecuencias...

programme.title: Cegados por el sol
programme.desc: Luca Guadagnino, el aclamado director de "Yo soy el amor", vuelve con una intenso thriller sexual protagonizado por Ralph Fiennes, Dakota Johnson, Matthias Schonaerts y Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: Tránsito
programme.desc: Historia de suspense de un psiquiatra de Nueva York que intenta detener el suicidio planeado de un joven paciente inusual en la víspera de su 21 cumpleaños.

programme.title: Los consejos del Dr. Bird para poetas tristes
programme.desc: James Whitman es un joven de 16 años que vive en un mundo imaginario y complejo.

programme.title: Eisenstein en Guanajuato
programme.desc: 1931, tras el éxito mundial de su película "El Acorazado Potemkin", el director Sergei Eisenstein viaja a la ciudad de Guanajuato, Mejico, para rodar una nueva película. Rechazado por la implacable industria de Hollywood, Eisenstein se deja seducir por el encanto y la frescura de su nuevo destino.

programme.title: Un Puñado de Polvo
programme.desc: Lady Brenda, hastiada de su vida, inicia un romance que sacude los cimientos de su mundo.

programme.title: Yo Quiero a Eva
programme.desc: Eva es invitada a festejar el cumpleaños de su vecino, sin sospechar que es una cita romántica.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo y dos adorables hijos.

programme.title: No Quiero Ser Recuerdo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Vega conoce a alguien que devolverá el color a su vida.

programme.title: Abajo el amor
programme.desc: Nueva York, 1962. Barbara Novak es una escritora feminista cuyo libro "Abajo el amor", se ha convertido en la guía que siguen las mujeres de todo el mundo. Convencido de que Novak es un fraude, el reportero estrella de una revista masculina intenta desenmascararla, haciendo que se enamore de él...

programme.title: Dust: cenizas y pólvora
programme.desc: El autor de la aclamada "Before the Rain" vuelve a entrelazar historias en tiempo y espacio para narrar esta curiosa película, mitad drama ambientado en el Nueva York actual, mitad western ambientado en los Balcanes a principios de siglo.

programme.title: Mi super ex-novia
programme.desc: Matt Saunders es un joven neoyorquino que se enamora de Jenny Johnson, una chica aparentemente normal que resulta ser G-Girl, una superheroína. Cuando Matt decide acabar con la relación, Jenny decidirá hacer uso de sus superpoderes para hacer de la vida de Matt un auténtico infierno...

programme.title: Fresa y chocolate
programme.desc: David es un comunista convencido que estudia sociología en la Universidad de La Habana. Diego es un artista homosexual acosado por la homofobia del régimen castrista. A pesar de las abismales diferencias que los separan, entre ellos surge una profunda amistad.

programme.title: Asesino a sueldo
programme.desc: Viktor creció en los suburbios de Rumanía y conoce el valor de la vida, lo que lo convierte en el asesino perfecto. Después de ser traicionado por aquellos que consideraba sus amigos, debe fingir su propia muerte y huir a Londres, donde se une a una nueva familia de gánsteres.

programme.title: Caramel
programme.desc: En Beirut, varias mujeres se reúnen en un salón de belleza, un microcosmos colorista y sensual. Layale ama a un hombre casado. Nisrine, que es musulmana y está a punto de casarse, tiene un serio problema: ya no es virgen. Rima se siente atraída por las mujeres. El problema de Jamel es que se resiste a envejecer. Rose ha sacrificado su vida para cuidar de su hermana que padece demencia senil.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth, duque de Escocia, recibe una profecía de un trío de brujas que dice que un día se convertirá en rey de Escocia. Consumido por la ambición y alentado a la acción por su propia esposa, Macbeth asesina al rey y ocupa su trono.

programme.title: Sin vuelta atrás
programme.desc: Tras salir de la cárcel en libertad condicional, Joey se va a vivir con su hermano Tommy a Staten Island. Tommy, casado con una atractiva mujer, se dedica a trapichear con marihuana. Al principio, ella siente cierto rechazo hacia Joey, pero pronto surge entre ellos una buena amistad.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: La Coartada
programme.desc: Ray Elliott tiene un trabajo muy especial: se dedica a encubrir las relaciones matrimoniales de sus clientes.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Rockero rescata a su esposa secuestrada en Chile.

programme.title: Cortes Peligrosos
programme.desc: Cuatro estilistas de Dublin se convierten en justicieras accidentales y héroes de la comunidad.

programme.title: 50 sombras muy oscuras
programme.desc: Por fin descubriremos qué pasaría si Christian Grey fuera negro en lugar de blanco, rico y en lugar de tener un cuarto rojo del dolor tuviera una sala de juegos de colores… Divertida comedia protagonizada por Marlon Wayans y con un desternillante guión, escrito por él mismo y Rick Alvarez.

programme.title: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland
programme.desc: Cuando un decano de Blue Mountain State amenaza con cerrar la Hermandad de la Cabra, Alex y el equipo deben atraer a Thad Castle de regreso de la NFL con el mayor festival de alcohol en la historia de BMS.

programme.title: La muerte de Stalin
programme.desc: La noche del 2 de marzo de 1953 murió un hombre. Ese hombre es Josef Stalin, dictador, tirano, carnicero y Secretario General de la URSS. Y si juegas bien tus cartas, el puesto ahora puede ser tuyo.

programme.title: Cómo satisfacer a una mujer
programme.desc: Cuando su negocio de limpieza de casas exclusivamente para el sexo masculino se sale de control, una mujer madura debe abrazar su propia sexualidad, si quiere hacer una nueva vida para sí misma.

programme.title: La Cruda Realidad
programme.desc: Para conseguir al hombre perfecto tendrá que escuchar al peor de todos

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: Shelley lleva una vida alegre hasta que una rival hace que la echen de la Mansión Playboy. Sin ningún sitio adonde ir, el destino la lleva a la hermandad femenina de Zeta Alpha Zeta. A menos que chicas nuevas quieran inscribirse, las siete jóvenes socialmente inadaptadas perderán su casa a manos de las confabuladoras chicas de Phi Iota Mu. Para conseguir su objetivo, necesitan que Shelley les enseñe el modo de maquillarse y de seducir a los hombres. Al mismo tiempo, Shelley necesita algo que tienen las Zetas, sentido de la individualidad. La combinación lleva a todas las chicas a aprender cómo dejar de fingir y empezar a ser ellas mismas.

programme.title: Rumores Y Mentiras
programme.desc: El guión, obra del dramaturgo Bert V. Royal, es una versión moderna y en clave estudiantil de “La letra escarlata”, la novela de Nathaniel Hawthorne. Narra la historia de una joven que decide fingir que lleva una vida promiscua, creyendo que así obtendrá algún tipo de beneficio. Sin embargo, las circunstancias se volverán en su contra.

programme.title: Con Derecho A Roce
programme.desc: Una cazatalentos y su nuevo cliente, ambos salidos de sendas relaciones desastrosas, hacen un pacto: serán "amigos con derecho a roce". Y si alguno de ellos se implica demasiado emocionalmente, dejarán de mantener relaciones sexuales. Aunque al principio el trato funciona, pronto los dos se enamoran y deben reconsiderar lo que significan el uno para el otro.

programme.title: Eminence Hill
programme.desc: Un rastro de venganza lleva a un famoso asesino y un abogado a una ciudad de fanáticos, en donde la sangre fluirá.

programme.title: ...Y le llamaban El Halcón
programme.desc: Gianni Garko regresa como el Espíritu Santo, un pistolero sobrenatural vestido de blanco y con una paloma al hombro.

programme.title: Tulsa, ciudad de lucha
programme.desc: En Tulsa, tras la muerte de un ranchero en una disputa con una gran compañía petrolera, su hija, movida por la venganza, empieza a buscar petróleo.

programme.title: Tormenta en Arizona
programme.desc: Película de vaqueros publicada en 1956 dirigida por Joseph Kane y protagonizada por Skip Homeier: Tomenta en Arizona - Se descubre una rica veta de mineral en una mina de plata cerca de un pequeño pueblo. El corrupto alcalde casi consigue hacerse con el control de la mina.

programme.title: Ana Caulder
programme.desc: Tras ser brutalmente atacada y perder a su esposo, Hannie Caulder jura venganza contra los tres forajidos responsables. Con la ayuda del cazarrecompensas Thomas Price, aprende a manejar un arma y se convierte en una pistolera letal. Mientras los hermanos Clemens continúan su ola de crímenes, Hannie se prepara para enfrentarlos y hacer justicia.

programme.title: The Challenger
programme.desc: Jaden Miller, un mecánico del Bronx en apuros, recurre al boxeo para salvarse a sí mismo y a su madre de quedarse sin hogar. Con un entrenador legendario, y un reality show construido a su alrededor, Miller va por el título.

programme.title: Some Be
programme.desc: Tras la aparición de un virus que elimina la voluntad y la conciencia, la sociedad colapsa. En medio del caos, Esteban y Sarah deben luchar por sobrevivir, enfrentándose no solo al peligro del contagio, sino también a lo que queda de la humanidad.

programme.title: Pueblo de cenizas
programme.desc: Miriam es atacada por el Duende, un ente sobrenatural que, bajo su apariencia inofensiva, sirve a las pasiones humanas y defiende con ferocidad su territorio. Un encuentro que revela el lado más oscuro de lo mágico y lo convierte en amenaza.

programme.title: El Verano que te Vimos
programme.desc: Luego de un año sin verse, un grupo de amigos se reencuentra para festejar año nuevo en las sierras cordobesas. Durante el transcurso de los días resurgirán tensiones del pasado y conflictos que tarde o temprano deberán ser enfrentados.

programme.title: La maldición 2
programme.desc: El fantasma de Kayako sigue al acecho. Tatsuya Suzuki, un agente de bienes raíces, le pide a su hija Kyouko que vaya a la casa en la que Kayako y Kobayashi fueron asesinados (y donde también se produjo la desaparición de la familia Murakami). Kyouko logra ver el fantasma de Kayako y esto le da motivo para iniciar su propia investigación sobre los hechos, llegando a la conclusión que Kayako fue muerta en la casa de Kobayashi. Tatsuya vende la casa encantada al matrimonio de los Kitada.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Persecución
programme.desc: El detective Breslin se cruza con Calloway, un hacker despiadado desesperado por encontrar a su esposa que ha sido secuestrada por un cartel de la droga. Cuando Calloway escapa de la custodia policial, Breslin une fuerzas con una policía sensata para recuperar a su prisionera. Pero, sospecha que el padre de Calloway y jefe del crimen está involucrado de alguna manera.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: Musarañas
programme.desc: Montse padece agorafobia pero no lo sabe y se esconde de la vida, entre cuatro paredes. Trabaja de costurera y el único eslabón que la une con la realidad es su hermana. Un día, Carlos, cae por la escaleras y pide ayuda llamando a su puerta.

programme.title: Carmen
programme.desc: La naturaleza libre y enigmática de una mujer llamada Carmen, su belleza meridional, su carácter arrebatado y pasional, hacen que el sargento José se convierta en víctima y protagonista de acontecimientos extraordinarios.

programme.title: Amateurs
programme.desc: Marsella (Francia): El día que Blanca cumple 16 años, su madre muere sepultada bajo tres toneladas de pescado, quedando sola en la vida. Vallecas (Madrid): Julio Nieves, un fornido capataz de la construcción de 65 años, cae desplomado en su ducha. A partir de ahora se enfrenta a su dura jubilación.

programme.title: El niño de barro
programme.desc: En 1912, en Buenos Aires, una serie de niños son asesinados de manera brutal. Mateo, un niño de diez años, oculta que en sus pesadillas es testigo de los crímenes, pero cuando la policía lo descubre, se convierte en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Un misterio para Aurora Teagarden: El juego del gato y el raton
programme.desc: Aurora Teagarden volvera a enfrentarse a la resolucion de un nuevo crimen cuando un misterioso criminal empieza a dejarle enigmaticas pistas.

programme.title: El Merchi
programme.desc: En una ciudad violenta, un hombre luchará por lo que cree.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: The Sadist
programme.desc: Three teachers are treated to an afternoon of horror when a maniacal killer interrupts their trip to Dodger Stadium.

programme.title: Spider Baby
programme.desc: An inbred family is visited in their rural mansion by greedy distant relatives intent on taking the family home and inheritance.

programme.title: Tomb Invader
programme.desc: La arqueóloga Alabama Channing es reclutada por un misterioso multimillonario para que le ayude a encontrar una antigua reliquia china. El mismo tesoro que buscaba su madre antes de desaparecer.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: En nombre de la justicia
programme.desc: Un sheriff retirado de los Rangers de Texas debe volver a las armas cuando una peligrosa banda de moteros toma su pequeño pueblo y amenaza con sembrar el caos y la violencia.

programme.title: Dead Man Down (La venganza del hombre muerto)
programme.desc: Espectacular historia de venganza en forma de frenético thriller sobre dos personas obsesionadas y heridas por el pasado, la mano derecha de un mafioso (Colin Farrell) y una misteriosa mujer víctima de un crimen, que juntos llevarán a cabo un oscuro y violento plan de venganza.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de un despiadado jefe mafioso, un conductor que se da a la fuga después de un violento atraco deberá entregar a un joven miembro de la banda en una emboscada para ejecutarlo.

programme.title: Amenaza terrorista
programme.desc: Ewan es un agente del Servicio Secreto cuya misión consiste en capturar y eliminar a Ash, un terrorista suicida, y a la célula a la que pertenece. Mientras tanto, Ash se enfrenta a un dilema moral.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Tras una pandemia, John protege a María, portadora de una posible cura, de unos mercenarios.

programme.title: Inferno

Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.
